description: We are a team from IBA College of Mindanao, Inc., passionate about technology, programming, and problem-solving. We are excited to join NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026 to learn new skills, collaborate, and develop innovative solutions to real-world problems. As a team, we aim to share ideas, explore new possibilities, and use our creativity and technical knowledge to create a meaningful project. Together, we are ready to learn, innovate, and explore the next frontier!
